STEP 2 - Vessel: White rectangular-square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roasted chicken pieces (two pieces, one larger bone-in piece and one drumstick/thigh-like piece)
- Seasoned rice (brown-orange, tomato-seasoned)
- Corn on the cob (two rounds)

- Chicken pieces: ~17% = 90 cm² x 2.0 cm = 180 ml x 0.95 = 171 g x 190 kcal/100g = 325 kcal
- Rice: ~20% = 106 cm² x 1.5 cm = 159 ml x 0.8 = 127 g x 150 kcal/100g = 191 kcal
- Corn: ~8% = 42 cm² x 2.5 cm = 106 ml x 0.6 = 64 g x 96 kcal/100g = 61 kcal

Food covers ~45% of the plate, consistent with the visible spread.

STEP 5 - Volume: see per-item values above (gross envelope).

STEP 6 - Grams: chicken ~171 g, rice ~127 g, corn ~64 g. Total ≈ 362 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: chicken 325 kcal, rice 191 kcal, corn 61 kcal. Total ≈ 577 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A plate about half covered with a chicken serving, a rice portion, and two corn rounds at ~360 g and ~580 kcal is plausible for a single meal. The chicken kcal assumes skin and fat are partly present; the estimate is approximate.
